description: Source file implementing the CmduMessageTx class for constructing and managing IEEE 1905.1 protocol messages, including methods for creating, loading, finalizing messages, and adding vendor-specific TLVs.

classes.name: CmduMessageTx
classes.description: Class for constructing and transmitting IEEE 1905.1 protocol messages, with methods for creating, loading, adding TLVs, finalizing, and calculating message size.

methods.name: CmduMessageTx
methods.description: Constructor initializing the message with a buffer and length.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new message with specified ID and message type, setting relay indicator if applicable.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads an existing message for processing.

methods.name: add_vs_tlv
methods.description: Adds a vendor-specific TLV with specified OUI.

methods.name: finalize
methods.description: Finalizes the message by adding end-of-message TLV and completing the buffer.

methods.name: elements_in_message
methods.description: Calculates how many elements of a given size can fit into the remaining MTU-sized buffer.
